entities.name: keeper.md
entities.description: Standard work document for the fire keeper role, written 2026-08-21, describing weekly maintenance tasks and cadence for a software project.

entities.name: Henri
entities.description: The person for whom this document is written; the fire keeper who performs the weekly ritual.

entities.name: spec/rules.md
entities.description: The five capped method documents that sessions read before knowing what they are working on; contains the rotation contract.

entities.name: vision.md
entities.description: A document establishing that the ritual won't demand presence and that missed sessions are not failures.

entities.name: test/gates.md
entities.description: Output page from the gates check showing two rows: Rules and Journal status.

entities.name: python3 tools/suite.py --gates
entities.description: Command that runs twelve structural checks in about fourteen seconds and generates the gates report.

entities.name: python3 tools/rulecount.py
entities.description: Tool that shows the line count for rules, used to track rule cap.

entities.name: python3 tools/journalroll.py
entities.description: Tool that manages journal rotation and closing with themes.

entities.name: doc/memory/decisions-arrive-shaped.md
entities.description: Contract document specifying the format and quality requirements for decision cards that sessions must follow.

entities.name: card:memory-atrophy.md
entities.description: Card related to memory recall measurement, referenced for move 1 on 2026-08-24.

entities.name: python3 tools/sittings.py --days 7
entities.description: Tool that measures sitting limit compliance over the past week, showing count, duration, and follow-up patterns.

entities.name: tools/gapcheck.py
entities.description: Tool that reads the ledger for the 30-minute silence rule measurement.

entities.name: board/later/
entities.description: Board section containing cards waiting on events or decisions, reviewed in act 4.

entities.name: board/done/
entities.description: Board section recording completed work with dates, used to counter doubt with evidence.

entities.name: doc/memory/
entities.description: Memory documents recording allegedly difficult parts already completed with dates.

entities.name: card:online.md
entities.description: Card for music pages that live on the gh-pages branch.

entities.name: examples/audio/
entities.description: Directory containing audio pieces that are published as tabs on the music pages.

entities.name: tools/pages.sh
entities.description: Script that generates music pages, commits to gh-pages branch, and pushes updates.

entities.name: gh-pages
entities.description: Git branch where music pages and audio tabs are published.

entities.name: spec/author.md
entities.description: Document defining the author's role and authority, particularly for editing the five method documents.

entities.name: Read the lamps
entities.description: Act 1 of the fire: run gates check and review Rules and Journal status, takes about 1 minute.

entities.name: Open the decisions batch
entities.description: Act 2 of the fire: review shaped decision cards together, takes 10-20 minutes, approving defaults is the key move.

entities.name: Measure one rule
entities.description: Act 3 of the fire: test one rule against the week that happened using closed-book recall, takes 10 minutes.

entities.name: One pass over the pile
entities.description: Act 4 of the fire: review board/later/ cards to distinguish sediment from debt, takes 10 minutes.

entities.name: Rotate the journal
entities.description: Act 5 of the fire: skim closing month, promote lines to method files, write index, and close the file, takes 30 minutes when lamp indicates.

entities.name: Push the pieces
entities.description: Act 6 of the fire: update music pages on gh-pages branch when pieces change, takes 5 minutes, done as needed not every fire.

relations.description: Document written at Henri's request to address his uncertainty about the fire keeper task.
